name: 暖光质感滋补干货详情款
description: 深色暖光加琥珀金强调，从条形微距到炖煮场景的滋补干货详情页骨架

styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep warm charcoal #141210 for hero, macro and closing shots; warm cream #F7F2E8 for benefit, spec and trust screens; dark walnut #3A2A1C for the cooking scene
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm directional studio lighting, soft top-left key around 3400K with gentle rim separation, soft contact shadows, controlled warm highlights, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: dark walnut wood #3A2A1C, matte dark slate #1E1B18, and matte warm cream board #EFE7DA
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family for all headlines and labels; no brush, handwriting, ornate or serif lettering
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons in the amber-gold accent #C8912F, single line weight, rounded terminals
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent product scale across the set; product always resting on a real surface with a soft contact shadow, never floating
noDrift: no floating product without contact shadow
styleLock.lockText: consistent warm premium tonic visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep warm charcoal background #141210, warm cream #F7F2E8, dark walnut #3A2A1C and one amber-gold accent #C8912F; warm directional studio lighting with a soft top-left key around 3400K, gentle rim separation and soft contact shadows; a single modern geometric sans-serif family for all headlines and labels; consistent rounded rectangular info labels; consistent thin-line icons in the amber-gold accent; clean high-end warm product photography resting on dark walnut wood, matte dark slate or matte warm cream board surfaces, mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and stable product scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no brush or handwriting lettering, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no floating product without contact shadow.
